about: An adversarial answer written by hand, not recorded: a model padding the list past the cap, quoting words the note never used, pairing a topic with a quote it has nothing to do with, slipping advice in as a topic, and claiming a frequency it invented. A well-behaved model will not produce one, so it is authored to prove the pipeline refuses each of those.
noteBody: Day 2 after laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Call each morning for five days. Watch for fever, any discharge from the wound, and pain getting worse. Escalate to me if the wound is hot or she has a fever.

raw.goal: Find out how the wound is healing and whether the pain is getting worse.

watchPoints.text: whether the pain is getting worse
tell her it's safe to skip a dose while the pain is getting worse
